用 Google 登入時取得的名稱、電子郵件和大頭貼，只用來辨識你的帳號。: The name, email address and profile picture from your Google sign-in, used only to identify your account.
你上傳的考卷、照片和 PDF，以及由此產生的題目、作答紀錄和批改結果。: The exams, photos and PDFs you upload, plus the questions, answer history and grading results created from them.
你貼上的 AI 服務 API 金鑰，加密後才存進資料庫。: The AI service API keys you paste in, which are encrypted before being stored in the database.
加入班級時的成員關係，以及每次呼叫 AI 的用量紀錄（模型和字數，不含內容），用: Your class memberships, and a usage log for each AI call (model and length, not content), used to show what you've spent.
資料只用來提供 {brand} 的功能。辨識、批改、翻譯和問 AI 時，相關的頁: Your data is used only to provide {brand}'s features. When scanning, grading, translating or asking AI, the relevant page images, questions and answers are sent with your own key to the AI service you chose (such as Anthropic, OpenAI or Google) and are subject to that service's terms. With free translation, question text is sent to Google Translate (or MyMemory if that fails) without any of your account details. We don't sell data or use it for advertising.
預設只有你自己。你分享連結時，拿到連結並登入的人可以看到那份考卷；在班級裡，老師: By default, only you. When you share a link, anyone who has it and signs in can see that exam. In a class, teachers can see the work and scores students submit.
資料存放在 Supabase（資料庫與登入）和 Cloudflare R2（檔案: Data is stored in Supabase (database and sign-in) and Cloudflare R2 (files). Uploaded original files are deleted 30 days after the exam is saved to your bank, unless you choose to keep them. Compressed page images are kept with the exam.

你可以隨時在網站上刪除考卷、題目和測驗。想刪除整個帳號和所有資料，請聯絡網站管理: You can delete exams, questions and quizzes on the site at any time. To delete your whole account and all your data, contact the site administrator and we'll handle it within 30 days.

為了省 AI 用量：程式先自己比對答案（格式不同也算對，例如 1/2、0.5、½: To save on AI usage: the app checks answers itself first (different formats still count, e.g. 1/2, 0.5, ½), and only sends what it can't match to AI; everything is graded at once when you submit; and the same answer to the same question is only sent once. Multiple-choice and true/false questions never use AI.
題目不是介面語言時，做題畫面會有翻譯按鈕，題目和選項一起翻。覺得免費翻譯不夠好，: When a question isn't in your interface language, a translate button appears while answering, translating the question and choices together. If free translation isn't good enough, switch to AI translation (uses your API key).
金鑰加密後存在你的帳號裡，只有你能用，網頁上不會再顯示完整金鑰，也只會送到該家: Keys are encrypted and stored in your account. Only you can use them, the full key is never shown again on the site, and it's only sent to that AI service.
金鑰只存在這台電腦的資料夾裡（data/settings.json），網頁上不會: Keys are stored only in a folder on this computer (data/settings.json). The full key is never shown again on the site, and it's only sent to that AI service.
OpenRouter、DeepSeek、Groq、本機的 Ollama 等支援: OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Groq, a local Ollama and any other service that supports the OpenAI-compatible format can be connected. Once connected, auto mode includes them and uses the cheapest first.
向服務查詢這把金鑰能用的模型，加到清單裡: Ask the service which models this key can use and add them to the list
問答、計算、填空題，以及沒有標準答案的題目，交卷後由 AI 老師評分並寫評語；你: Written, calculation and fill-in-the-blank questions, plus questions without an answer key, are scored with feedback by the AI tutor after you submit. You can change the score yourself anytime. The model used follows the AI strength above.
需要先在下面加上任一家的 API 金鑰: Add an API key from any provider below first
上傳的原檔存 30 天（勾「永久保留原檔」的除外），頁面圖片和題目附圖會一直保留: Uploaded original files are kept for 30 days (except those marked “Keep original file forever”). Page images and question figures are kept indefinitely. The same image is stored only once, no matter how many places use it.
加上任一家的 API 金鑰後，這裡會顯示每種工作用哪個模型、大約花多少。: Once you add an API key from any provider, this shows which model each task uses and roughly what it costs.
指定模型後，強度只在那家沒有金鑰時才派上用場；指定的模型讀不了時，會換其他有金鑰: With a specific model chosen, strength only matters when that provider has no key. If the chosen model can't read something, another service with a key takes over.
用 Google 翻譯，不用金鑰也不花錢。: Uses Google Translate. No key needed, and it's free.
還沒有 API 金鑰，先用免費翻譯。: No API key yet, so free translation is used for now.
這把金鑰無效或沒有權限，所以沒有儲存。請確認複製完整。: This key is invalid or lacks permission, so it wasn't saved. Make sure you copied the whole key.
已儲存，但暫時連不上服務，無法確認金鑰。（{reason}）: Saved, but couldn't reach the service to check the key. ({reason})
先設定 API 金鑰。: Set up an API key first.
請替這個服務取個名字。: Please give this service a name.
服務拒絕了這把金鑰，所以沒有新增。請確認金鑰與網址。: The service rejected this key, so it wasn't added. Please check the key and URL.
已新增，但暫時連不上服務，模型請自己輸入。（{reason}）: Added, but couldn't reach the service. Please enter models yourself. ({reason})
找到 {n} 個模型，請挑要用的加進來。: Found {n} model(s). Pick the ones you want to add.
每種工作都用最便宜的模型。: Uses the cheapest model for every task.
平常用中階模型，沒把握的頁再交給最強的模型。: Uses mid-range models, and hands pages it's unsure about to the strongest model.
每種工作都用最準的模型，最貴。: Uses the most accurate model for every task. Costs the most.
只看得到對錯，看不到答案和詳解，加到題庫的副本也不含答案。: They only see right or wrong, not the answers or explanations, and copies added to their bank don't include answers.
只看得到對錯，看不到答案和詳解。: They only see right or wrong, not the answers or explanations.
練習時每做完一題，就能看那一題的答案和詳解；考試則是交卷後一起看。: In practice, they see each question's answer and explanation after finishing it; in a test, they see them all after submitting.
可以加到自己的題庫: Can add to their own bank
拿到連結的人能存一份副本，自己修改、反覆練習。: Anyone with the link can save a copy to edit and practice with.
上面的設定改了就直接套用到這個連結，之後開始做的人照新的設定。關閉後連結立刻失效: Changes to the settings above apply to this link right away; anyone who starts afterward gets the new settings. Turning off the link disables it immediately, and sharing again creates a new link.
一題一題做，做完就能看對錯和解析。: Go one question at a time and see right or wrong and the explanation as you go.
全部做完再交卷，交卷後才看分數。: Answer everything, then submit. You'll see your score after submitting.
已經在你的題庫裡，打開: Already in your bank. Open it
加進去的是你自己的副本，可以修改，不影響原本的考卷。: You'll get your own copy to edit. The original exam isn't affected.
這個連結已經關閉了。: This link has been turned off.
這份考卷還沒有題目。: This exam has no questions yet.
分享的人沒有開放加到題庫。: The person who shared this doesn't allow adding it to a bank.
空間不夠：已用 {used} MB，上限 {quota} MB。可以刪掉用不到的: Not enough space: {used} MB used of {quota} MB. Delete imports or exams you don't need, or uncheck “Keep original file forever”, then try again.
用 {primary}，沒把握的頁再用 {escalate} 讀一次；讀不了時換: Uses {primary}, rereads unsure pages with {escalate}, and switches to {fallbacks} if it can't read them
用 {primary}，沒把握的頁再用 {escalate} 讀一次: Uses {primary}, and rereads unsure pages with {escalate}
用 {primary}；讀不了時換 {fallbacks}: Uses {primary}, and switches to {fallbacks} if it can't read them
網址格式不對，例如 https://openrouter.ai/api/v1: That URL isn't valid. Example: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
網址要以 https:// 開頭。: The URL must start with https://.
網址裡不能放帳號密碼，金鑰請填在金鑰欄。: Don't put a username or password in the URL. Enter your key in the key field.
上線版只能接 https:// 的服務。: The live version can only connect to https:// services.
找不到這個網址的伺服器。: Couldn't find a server at this URL.
上線版不能接本機或內部網路的服務；本機模型請在自己電腦上跑 Sheetloop。: The live version can't connect to services on your computer or a private network. To use local models, run Sheetloop on your own computer.
測試用 · 點這裡切換身分: For testing · Tap to switch identity
只在 pnpm dev 出現，正式版不會有: Only appears in pnpm dev, never in production
清除整頁（可以復原）: Clear the whole page (can be undone)
鉛筆或黑筆（整格清空重打字）: Pencil or black pen (wipe the blank and retype)
直接打字：/ 是分數、^ 是次方、sqrt 是根號，Enter 完成；平板會出現: Just type: / for fractions, ^ for powers, sqrt for square roots, Enter to finish. Tablets show a math keyboard.
要練習的字，例如：永 春天: Characters to practise, e.g. 永 春天
每一行先看第一格的字，描過淡色的字，再自己寫滿整行。: In each row, look at the first character, trace the faint ones, then fill the row on your own.
這題還沒有要練習的字，請到題庫編輯答案。: This question has no characters to practise yet. Add them to its answer in the question bank.
AI 讀到的字（? 是寫錯或認不出的字）: What the AI read (? marks a wrong or unreadable character)
用 Google 帳號登入，名稱和頭像跟著 Google。: Signed in with Google; your name and picture come from your Google account.
這張圖片讀不出來，換一張試試。: This picture couldn't be read. Try another one.
